text:
sam: FYI folks — PR 47821 updates authz checks in the router and tweaks eviction thresholds in the runtime allocator. Need cross-team eyes (runtime: @maya, infra: @liam, security: @jin). Can we get async reviews? https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infra/pull/47821 :eyes:

ci-bot: CI passed — unit tests and e2e green.

maya: I can take the runtime eviction/kernel bits. Quick Q: does the allocator change LRU semantics or only thresholds?

sam: It's thresholds + a small refactor to make eviction prefetch-aware. No LRU algorithm change. Short snippet below for the eviction delta: ```diff
@@ -74,7 +74,10 @@
-  if (free < min_free) evict();
+  // increase min_free under heavy prefix cache usage
+  if (prefix_cache_pressure > 0.7) {
+    min_free += threshold_delta;
+  }
+  if (free < min_free) evict();
```

liam: I'll look at the authz/router changes. Also need a canary plan + rollback criteria before we ship.

sam: Canary plan (draft):
- Step 1: deploy to eu-dev canary with feature flag enabled for 10% of routing traffic.
- Step 2: monitor p99 latency, eviction rate, cache hit ratio, and authz errors for 2h.
- Rollback if eviction rate > baseline * 3 OR p99 latency increases by >50ms OR any authz denial spike.
Will add dashboards and alert thresholds to the PR.

jin: security note: authz change touches a route header we use for tenant isolation. Please add a short threat-model blurb and a test that validates header integrity (HMAC or header signing check). Also confirm audit log events still include the original route/tenant fields. :lock:

sam: Good call — will add threat model + test. Looping in @oliver from platform for rollout gating and audit log preservation.

oliver: I can own rollout. Put the change behind a feature flag and a kill-switch in config. Also we must ensure audit logs are preserved in the same schema (no dropped fields).

maya: skimmed the diff, left a couple tiny nits inline. Main runtime ask: add a unit test for eviction boundary so we don't regress cache invalidation behavior on threshold bumps. If that test is added, LGTM from runtime.

sam: Uploading patch now with tests + threat model.

deploy-bot: PR 47821 branch updated, CI green.

liam: quick infra Q — does this require quota or infra-level config changes? If yes, cc infra-ops; if not, ignore.

sam: No infra quota changes — only default config values (tunable).

oliver: Scheduling canary for Thu 10:00 PST unless objections. Will check rollback automation.

maya: I'm available for the first hour of the canary to help triage runtime metrics.

jin: I'll review the threat model tonight and flag blockers early.

sam: Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll ping again once the PR includes the test + threat model and when the canary is scheduled.
